enable_plpython3.description: Enable PL/Python 3 procedural language (plpython3u) for use in databases.

plpython3_path.description: Optional colon-separated list of directories to prepend to sys.path in PL/Python procedures. Leave empty to use the system default Python path.

plpython3_max_recursion.description: Maximum recursion depth for PL/Python functions. Set to 0 to use Python's default recursion limit (usually 1000). Higher values may cause stack overflow.

plpython3_python_home.description: Optional path to Python home directory (where Python binaries and libraries reside). Used to isolate PL/Python from system Python.
